Metadata.rootDescription: NextAtlet helps young judo athletes build a strong digital identity — automatically generated websites, professional photos, and a network of mentors that opens doors to sponsorships.
Metadata.authDescription: Log in or create a profile on NextAtlet.

HeroSection.subtitle: NextAtlet helps young judo athletes build a strong digital identity — with automatically generated websites, professional photos, and a network of mentors that opens doors to sponsorship opportunities.

Offerings.title: Everything a young athlete needs
Offerings.description: Three connected services that together build a credible and professional digital identity — from your first competition to your first sponsor.

website.title: Athlete website
website.description: An automatically generated website that showcases your career, your results, and your story. Choose the level that fits you — from a simple profile to a fully customized brand.

photography.title: Professional photography
photography.description: Professional photos for your website — and for personal use. We shoot at competitions or in rented studios. You own the images. They last your entire career.

mentoring.title: Mentor network
mentoring.description: Guides, sparring, and a network of former athletes who know the path to sponsors. We help you write your first outreach and stand strong in the negotiation.

HowItWorks.title: From sign-up to sponsor in just a few weeks

profile.title: Create your profile
profile.description: Fill in your details — club, weight class, results. Your website is generated automatically and ready in under 10 minutes.

photoshoot.title: Book a photo session
photoshoot.description: Choose a competition or our studio in your region. We deliver professional action shots and portraits you can use anywhere.

visible.title: Become visible and searchable
visible.description: Your profile is indexed locally and nationally, so sponsors, clubs, and media can find you when they search for talent.

sponsor.title: Land your first sponsor
sponsor.description: Our mentors guide you in handling inquiries and closing deals that strengthen — not compromise — your career.

Photography.title: Images that speak for you
Photography.description: Professional photos from competitions and studios. You own them — use them anywhere.

Pricing.title: Choose your level
Pricing.description: Start for free and upgrade when you're ready to take your career to the next level.

Testimonial.quote: Sponsors aren't looking for the best athlete. They're looking for the most visible athlete.
Testimonial.author: Thomas Bech, former national team judoka & mentor at NextAtlet

Cta.body: Create your free profile in under 10 minutes and become visible to sponsors, media, and clubs across Denmark.

Footer.blurb: Digital presence and sponsorship platform for young judo athletes in Denmark.

chooseType.title: Who is the profile for?
chooseType.subtitle: Choose who you're creating a profile for.

self.title: Myself
self.description: I'm the athlete and I'm creating my own profile.

guardian.title: My child
guardian.description: I'm creating a profile for my child as a parent/guardian.

self.title: Create your profile
self.subtitle: Fill in your details — your website is generated automatically.

guardian.title: Create a profile for your child
guardian.subtitle: You become the guardian of the profile and can fill it in until your child is ready to take over.

form.guardianNote: Since you're under 16, we'll send a consent request to your parent. Your profile can only be published once they've approved.

validation.slugPattern: Only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens
validation.belowFloor: You must be at least 13 to create your own profile. Ask a parent to create it for you.
validation.guardianRequired: A parent's email is required for athletes under 16 — we'll send them a consent request.
validation.adultMustSelfRegister: A person aged 18 or over must create their own profile.

ready.title: Your profile has been created
ready.body: You're all set. Go to your dashboard to add a bio, results, and choose a theme.

consentPending.title: Almost ready — we need consent
consentPending.body: We've sent a consent request to your parent. Your profile has been created, but can only be published once they approve via the link in the email.

guardian.title: The child's profile has been created
guardian.body: You are now the guardian of the profile. Go to your dashboard to fill in the details — the profile can be published whenever you're ready.

Editor.title: Your site
Editor.subtitle: This is your draft. You'll build your profile here once we add sections and themes.
Editor.sectionsBody: Add and arrange the sections on your site — results, gallery, about you, and more.
Editor.themesBody: Pick a theme and customize colors and fonts so the site looks like you.
